```{r}
#| include: false
root <- here::here()
if (!exists("GistmTable", inherits = FALSE)) {
  GistmTable <- data.table(Class = c("Low", "Significant", "High", "Very High", "Extreme"), PAR = CONTENT$columns[["PAR"]],
      Consequences = CONTENT$columns[["Consequences"]], `Operations and Active-Care Closure` = c("1/200",
      "1/1,000", "1/2,475", "1/5,000", "1/10,000"), `Passive-Care Post-Closure` = c("1/10,000",
      "1/10,000", "1/10,000", "1/10,000", "1/10,000"))
  setnames(GistmTable, CONTENT$headers)
  GistmNotes <- CONTENT$notes
}
```
